subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should oversized cron quarantine sidecars preserve all previously quarantined records through a canonical repairable store, or may later overflows permanently replace older quarantined data?
rationale: The sidecar is used to retain malformed persisted cron records for later repair, and the PR changes that retention guarantee; source inspection cannot determine whether permanent loss after repeated overflow is an accepted product contract.

options.title: Preserve quarantined records
options.body: Keep bounded reads and use a non-destructive canonical retention or doctor-migration path so repeated overflows do not erase earlier records.

options.title: Accept bounded archive loss
options.body: Document that only the current sidecar and most recent overflow archive are retained, accepting permanent loss of older malformed entries.

recommendation.title: Preserve quarantined records
recommendation.body: Keep bounded reads and use a non-destructive canonical retention or doctor-migration path so repeated overflows do not erase earlier records.
